Name: The Melting Pot
Author: Unicornkiitty
Description:
Welcome to "The Melting Pot" mod—a culinary adventure where flavors from every continent come together in delightful harmony! This mod not only spices up your menu with the 6 recipes books you can purchase at the Desert Trader, but also introduces a brand-new feature using the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]ItemExtension ﻿[/url]framework! Stop by Gus’s to grab the corona box, packed with six refreshing Corona bottles—perfect for celebrations! Don’t miss the packaged Guava at Pierre's either! This tasty item grants you a Solid Guava bar, separate from the recipe that's included! Visit the Desert Trader and trade everyday items to get a little taste of the world beyond the hills of Stardew Valley right to your cozy little kitchen! Each food item also features a unique punny description if you like a little humor! :P

[code][code][IMG]https://i.postimg.cc/cHHZJ2LK/features.png[/IMG][/code][/code]:
[list]
[*][b]Global Cuisine[/b]: A variety of recipes of food from around the globe.
[*][b]Corona Box[/b]: Purchase this new item at Gus’s to get six refreshing Corona bottles for those celebratory moments.
[*][b]Packaged Guava[/b]: Available at Pierre’s, this item provides a Solid Guava bar as an alternative to its recipe.
[*][b]Packaged Malsouka Sheets[/b]: Available at Pierre’s, this item provides 5 Malsouka Sheets as an alternative to its recipe.

[*]Pierre also includes imported items you'll need for several recipes
[*][b]Optional: [/b]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url]﻿ for the recipes that include meat, please grab [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkey[/url]﻿! There's also a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27938]Soy Bean alternative mod[/url]﻿ for Animal Husbandry! that replaces the meats for Soy bean alternatives!
[/list]
[code][IMG]https://i.postimg.cc/mrjX5njr/compatible-with.png[/IMG]
[/code][list]
[*][b]NEW: [/b]Now Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿
[/list]
You can also join my brand new [url=https://discord.gg/jgK6NMzSMr]Discord[/url]﻿ server, not only if you want to share food suggestions, make friends, or just keep up to date with the mod, but also because it's easier for me to take any feedback apart from bug reports, [b]PLEASE keep bug reports here on Nexus![/b]

[b]All Configs are turned off by default, You must go to the config and enable the recipes you want![/b]
